suggestions.title: Automated daily re-fetch of every official URL with a change log
suggestions.problem: Schedule PDFs, structure sheets and fee pages change without notice. 'Last checked' is only meaningful if it is kept current.
suggestions.proposal: A scheduled GitHub Action re-fetches every URL in the source register each morning, stores a hash and a snapshot, and opens an issue plus a Changes-page entry whenever a page differs from the stored snapshot. Rows whose source changed get a badge.
suggestions.value: High - this is the single biggest source of silent drift.
suggestions.status: Proposed - part built (workflow + Changes page scaffold); first automated run still to be observed.

suggestions.title: Per-event 'confirmed by the room' field
suggestions.problem: Single-entry status cannot be verified from official documents at all (flag F01). The site can only report what the sheets say.
suggestions.proposal: Add a field per event for the poker room's written answer, with the date and the name of the person who answered. Until it is filled the row stays 'unconfirmed'.
suggestions.effort: Low to build, requires the phone call to populate.
suggestions.value: Highest - it closes the main gap in the whole plan.

suggestions.title: Live hotel rate capture with a dated log
suggestions.problem: No official page publishes a static date-specific rate (flag F-H1).
suggestions.proposal: A form on the Hotels page lets you paste an itemised quote (base rate, resort fee, tax) for a named hotel and date range. Entries append to a dated rate log rather than overwriting, so you can see how a quote moved over time.
suggestions.value: High - it is the only way to get a real like-for-like comparison.
suggestions.status: Proposed - rate log schema is in the data model and empty by design.

suggestions.title: Field-size and finish-time tracking from official results
suggestions.problem: Finish times are not published, so the overlap check can only compare registration windows (flag F06).
suggestions.proposal: As the series runs, the official Results column on the Venetian structures page publishes field sizes and payouts. Capture those per event, then model a plausible finish time from the field size and level structure, and re-run the overlap check on modelled rather than assumed times.
suggestions.value: High - it turns the overlap check from a warning into a real plan.

suggestions.title: One page per venue, each with its own events, hotels and rules
suggestions.problem: The table currently covers one venue, so venue comparisons are not possible.
suggestions.proposal: Give every room (Venetian, Wynn, Bellagio, ARIA, and so on) its own page with its schedule, structure-sheet links, entry-rule fields and attached hotels, then roll them up on the Events page.
suggestions.value: High once more than one room is covered.
suggestions.status: Built for the Venetian; other venues need their schedules verified first.

suggestions.title: Trip cost calculator: entries x buy-in + nights x true nightly cost
suggestions.problem: Buy-in totals and hotel totals were being considered separately.
suggestions.proposal: A single calculator that takes the selected events and the nights, applies the verified resort fee and 13.38% tax, and returns the all-in trip cost. It also shows the guaranteed pool per dollar of entry as a descriptive ratio, clearly labelled as not a forecast.
suggestions.value: High - it is the number you actually budget against.

suggestions.title: Search across every table
suggestions.problem: With 94 starts plus 17 hotels plus flags and questions, scanning is slow.
suggestions.proposal: One search box that filters tournaments, hotels, flags, questions and sources simultaneously, with a count of matches per section.

suggestions.title: Date-range selector and a single-entry/freezeout toggle
suggestions.problem: You only care about your dates, and only about single-entry events.
suggestions.proposal: A date range filter plus a toggle that hides everything that is not a confirmed single-entry freezeout, with a second toggle for bounty events.
suggestions.status: Built - the freezeout toggle stays off until the room confirms the policy (F01).

suggestions.title: Walking-route verification with a 30-minute limit filter
suggestions.problem: Distance claims were unverified in earlier passes.
suggestions.proposal: For each hotel-venue pair, store the Google Maps walking time and distance with the route URL, and a filter that hides anything over 30 minutes. Re-check routes on a schedule because street closures and pedestrian bridges change.
suggestions.status: Built for 17 hotels; ARIA fails the limit at 31 minutes.

suggestions.title: Retire the duplicate sites from earlier parallel sessions
suggestions.problem: The repository contains several overlapping static sites (root-level pages, docs/, verified/, planner/, single-entry/, site/poker3/) with conflicting data and unresolved flags.
suggestions.proposal: Keep one canonical dashboard and move the earlier artifacts to an archive folder so nothing is lost but only one site is maintained and published.
suggestions.value: High - it removes conflicting numbers from view.

suggestions.title: Structured rule fields per event: single-entry, re-entry, add-on, fee - each with a source excerpt and retrieval date
suggestions.problem: Entry rules were previously described in prose, which made them impossible to filter or audit.
suggestions.proposal: Store each rule as its own field, quoting the exact sentence from the official sheet and the date it was read, so a reader can check any row against the source in one click.

suggestions.title: Guaranteed pool divided by entry fee, shown as a descriptive ratio and labelled separately for bounty events
suggestions.problem: Ranking by guarantee or by buy-in alone is misleading.
suggestions.proposal: Show guaranteed pool / total entry fee as a ratio for comparison only, state plainly that it is not a forecast of your expected return, and put bounty and multi-flight events in their own labelled sections.
